reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "loki Fix semantics of label parsing logic of metrics and logs queries", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Queries that previously extracted multiple values into the same label will now extract only the first value, potentially changing query results.

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0.0 changes label parsing logic in metrics and logs queries to extract only the first label when multiple extractions into the same label are requested, instead of parsing all of them.
